properties.geometry_source: Channel and open Atlantic hand-routed by sea waypoints; the Strait of Belle Isle, the Gulf south of Anticosti and the Honguedo passage hand-routed and checked against Natural Earth 10m land; the St. Lawrence estuary from Gaspé past Tadoussac and Île d'Orléans to Quebec on the OSM Fleuve Saint-Laurent centerline
properties.note: Eustache's crossing, about 1644. No ship or route is recorded; the Strait of Belle Isle was the usual way into the Gulf for French ships then.

properties.geometry_source: Quebec–Montreal on the OSM St. Lawrence centerline (as journey leg 1); Lachine and Lake Saint-Louis hand-routed; the Ottawa River on chained OSM centerlines (Rivière des Outaouais) to Mattawa; the Mattawa River and the French River on chained OSM centerlines; Trout Lake and the La Vase portages, Lake Nipissing, Georgian Bay and the Wye hand-routed
properties.note: The canoe route of the Huron missions, about 1646: up the Ottawa and Mattawa, over to Lake Nipissing, down the French River and along Georgian Bay to Sainte-Marie near Midland.
